svg.title: Honesty and response time across monitoring conditions — Figure 3
svg.desc: Original published Figure 3, page 385, Wang et al. (2026), DOI 10.3724/SP.J.1041.2026.0381. Chinese labels translated to English. Original figure composition, numerical values, axes, data, error bars and arrows are unchanged. Significance marks follow the p values reported in the Results. Raster source with editable English text and documented significance overlays.
